resources.name: Team, blog & newsletter spreadsheet
resources.summary: Source of truth for member profiles. The Parsed Team Data tab is read by the scheduled roster sync.
resources.access: Restricted team access. Only the normalized Parsed Team Data tab is published as CSV for the sync.

resources.name: Website submission form
resources.summary: One form for team roster updates, blog articles, and newsletter-only submissions.
resources.access: Share the responder link with team members. Keep the form editor restricted to maintainers.

resources.name: Old team data response sheet
resources.summary: Previous team data response sheet, retained for reference. New team, blog, and newsletter data is handled in the current combined spreadsheet.
resources.access: Keep restricted to team maintainers; it may contain historical personal information.

resources.name: Article and newsletter uploads
resources.summary: DOCX articles and optional newsletter PDFs are processed by the website publishing workflow and copied to the site asset host.
resources.access: Keep the form and upload storage under the durable team account. Uploaded photos used on the public site are made public by link.

resources.name: Email updates spreadsheet
resources.summary: Will hold reader and sponsor opt-ins, confirmation status, and sponsor briefing drafts.
resources.access: Private. Subscriber names and email addresses must not be public.

resources.name: Crowdfunding ledger
resources.summary: Private finance tracker for reported and verified transfers, follow-up, and reward fulfilment.
resources.access: Finance admins only. Contains donor contact, shipping, transfer, and payment proof details.

resources.name: Crowdfunding transfer form
resources.summary: Public form for supporters to report a bank or UPI transfer and upload payment proof.
resources.access: Responder link is public when launched. Form editor and uploaded proof are restricted.

resources.name: Approved UPI QR image
resources.summary: Approved payment QR inserted into the crowdfunding transfer form.
resources.access: Confirm the QR points to the official team account before publishing the form.
